summary: Built and deployed an automated daily tech news briefing pipeline. Set up blogwatcher-cli v0.2.0 with 23 RSS feeds across security, JS/React, AI/ML, and OSS categories; wired a Python fetch script and cron job to deliver a curated Telegram briefing at 8AM IST. First automated run fired same evening, surfacing the TanStack 'Mini Shai Hulud' supply chain attack as the day's signal item.
highlights: Installed blogwatcher-cli v0.2.0 to /usr/local/bin; registered 23 RSS feeds across security, JS, AI, and OSS categories
Wrote ~/.hermes/scripts/tech-news-fetch.py as the fetch/summarize script for the briefing
Configured cron job (30 2 * * * UTC = 8AM IST) to deliver curated Telegram briefing; 16/18 feeds confirmed working after URL debugging
First automated briefing ran successfully; flagged TanStack npm supply chain attack (social-engineering, attacker gained npm publish rights ~May 10-11, no malicious publish occurred) as top signal
